input.fixture: inert virtual vessel ID and revision, equilibrium or transfer mode, 15–35 °C synthetic baseline
input.settings: virtual forcing boundary 50–80 °C in 5 °C increments, speed 100–1500 rpm when on, 1–300 virtual s per segment
input.state: heat enable, stir toggle, standby, vessel placement, modeled ideal probe

output.records: time-ordered segments on a common simulation clock; plate temperature, optional phantom temperature/probe, agitation and disabled/active boundary, modeled hot-top flag. A segment boundary can have two equal timestamps to encode an instantaneous control change.
output.identity: vessel ID and revision are preserved across all segments

failure: Stir or heat cannot start in virtual standby or without a vessel.
A missing vessel or probe yields null, not fabricated readings.
Invalid input or action reports an error without changing state.
limits: No thermal safety prediction, calibration, actual device operation, fluids, chemical/biological preparation, viscosity or flow/mixing information. RPM is agitation state only. Color and viewport rotation are illustrative.
